name: Cocktail Magic
source:
Welcome to the Speakeasy!

This is Japan, where the prohibition of alcohol has been enforced. Kirishima, a high school teacher, wanders into a "Speakeasy," an underground bar run in secret.

--There he meets a mafia boss?!

With the heartwarming theme of companionship, have conversations with these intriguing individuals and enjoy your time at the Speakeasy!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2501500/Cocktail_Magic/]Steam[/url]]
